fields.label: Default Cheques in Hand Account
fields.description: Notes receivable held at cashier — for recording received cheques before they are deposited or sent to the bank.

fields.label: Default Cheques in Clearing Account
fields.description: Cheques under collection (in clearing), between hand and final bank settlement.

fields.label: Default Payable Cheque Account
fields.description: Notes payable — default liability account for issued cheques.

fields.label: Default Protested Account
fields.description: Default account for protested or returned (bounced) cheques.

fields.label: Require Sayad Registration
fields.description: If unchecked, Sayad fields are optional

fields.label: Default Endorsement / Settlement Account (Receivable)
fields.description: Receivable Registered → Endorsed: GL debited instead of the endorsed party’s receivable (Dr settlement, Cr Cheques in Hand). Prefer a dedicated “endorsed cheques” or clearing account with no party. Per-PDC override: Post Dated Cheque → Endorsement Settlement Account.

fields.label: Journal Entry Descriptions
fields.description: Optional templates for Journal Entry narration (remarks/user remark) used by PDC posting. Leave empty to use built-in defaults.

fields.label: JE Remark — Register Receivable
fields.description: Default: Register receivable cheque — {cheque_no}

fields.label: JE Remark — Send Receivable to Bank
fields.description: Default: Send receivable cheque to bank — {cheque_no}

fields.label: JE Remark — Receivable Bounced
fields.description: Default: Receivable cheque bounced — {cheque_no}

fields.label: JE Remark — Return Receivable to Party
fields.description: Default: Return receivable cheque to party — {cheque_no}

fields.label: JE Remark — Endorse Receivable
fields.description: Default: Endorse receivable cheque — {cheque_no}

fields.label: JE Remark — Register Payable
fields.description: Default: Register payable cheque (supplier settlement) — {cheque_no}

fields.label: JE Remark — Cancel Registered Payable
fields.description: Default: Cancel registered payable cheque (reverse supplier settlement) — {cheque_no}

fields.label: JE Remark — Clear Payable
fields.description: Default: Clear payable cheque — {cheque_no}

fields.label: JE Remark — Returned Payable from Payee
fields.description: Default: Returned payable cheque from payee — {cheque_no}

fields.label: JE Remark — Cancel Issued Payable
fields.description: Default: Cancel issued payable cheque — {cheque_no}

fields.label: JE Remark — Replace Receivable after Bounce
fields.default: جایگزینی چک دریافتنی {cheque_no} پس از برگشت
fields.description: Default: Replace receivable cheque after bank bounce — {cheque_no}

fields.label: JE Remark — Replace Receivable after Return
fields.default: جایگزینی چک دریافتنی {cheque_no} پس از عودت
fields.description: Default: Replace receivable cheque after return — {cheque_no}

fields.label: JE Remark — Replace Issued Payable
fields.description: Default: Replace issued payable cheque — {cheque_no}

fields.label: JE Remark — Replace Returned Payable
fields.description: Default: Replace returned payable cheque — {cheque_no}

fields.label: JE Remark — Clear Receivable (from Registered)
fields.description: Default: Receivable PDC cleared at bank vs cheques in hand (no party on clear). — {cheque_no}

fields.label: JE Remark — Clear Receivable (from Sent to Bank)
fields.description: Default: Receivable PDC cleared at bank vs cheques in clearing (no party on clear). — {cheque_no}

fields.label: JE Remark — Clear Receivable (after Legal)
fields.description: Default: Receivable PDC cleared at bank after legal follow-up vs protested/clearing/in-hand (no party on clear). — {cheque_no}

fields.label: JE User Remark — Register Receivable (Legacy)
fields.default: چک {cheque_no} از {party} دریافت شد - ثبت چک
fields.description: Default: Cheque {cheque_no} received from party - PDC Register

fields.label: JE User Remark — Register Payable (Legacy)
fields.default: چک {cheque_no} به {party} پرداخت شد - ثبت چک
fields.description: Default: Cheque {cheque_no} issued to party - PDC Register

fields.label: PDC Mode of Payment (Payment Request)
fields.description: If a Payment Request uses this Mode of Payment, Desk recommends creating a Post Dated Cheque (deferred settlement). Any other mode follows the normal Payment Entry path. This is a path hint only—not used as the accounting source of truth.

fields.label: Other Settlement — Allowed Reference DocTypes
fields.description: Comma or newline separated DocType names. If empty, Other Settlement allocation rows are not allowed. Configure here only; list UI is not required for validation.

fields.label: Roles Allowed to Rollback Workflow
fields.description: One role per line. Users with any listed role may rollback submitted PDC workflow (Administrator always allowed).
